248 County Road 4963
Kempner, TX 76539
$340,000, 3 bed, 2.00 bath, 2,177 SF, MLS# 567761

This 3/2, 1994 2177 sq.ft. brick house has plenty to offer! It's all-electric with plenty of storage. The kitchen features a pantry. Near the kitchen is a huge closet and the utility room. This well-maintained house features a den, a sunroom, and an ensuite. There is an attached 2 car garage with a closet. For your projects, there is a workroom with AC and a carport too. The backyard is a great play area for kids and pets. There is a grey water tank for watering the landscape. The heat pump in the attic is great for energy savings. This fine brick home sits on an acre of land so no worries about too close neighbors. It is great for birding and all manner of wildlife. If you want to raise your family or retire with plenty of room for guests and grandkids, this is the place to be.

2 full bath
